description: This file defines classes and methods for managing BiDi protocol connections and sessions within Playwright, including message dispatching, session management, and event handling.

classes.name: BidiConnection
classes.description: Manages the BiDi connection, including message routing, session creation, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: BidiSession
classes.description: Represents a BiDi protocol session, handling message sending, callback management, and event emission.

methods.name: nextMessageId
methods.description: Generates the next unique message ID for protocol messages.

methods.name: rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message through the transport layer.

methods.name: _dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to the appropriate session or event handler.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles transport closure, cleans up state, and logs disconnection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the transport connection if not already closed.

methods.name: createMainFrameBrowsingContextSession
methods.description: Creates a new BiDi session for a given browsing context.

methods.name: addFrameBrowsingContext
methods.description: Associates a browsing context with the session.

methods.name: removeFrameBrowsingContext
methods.description: Removes association of a browsing context from the session.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a BiDi command and returns a promise for its response.

methods.name: sendMayFail
methods.description: Sends a command and logs errors without rejecting.

methods.name: isDisposed
methods.description: Checks if the session has been disposed.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the session, rejecting pending callbacks and cleaning up.

methods.name: hasCallback
methods.description: Checks if a callback exists for a given message ID.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to callbacks or emits events.
